name: Armor icon
description: Trait icon for Shell: its sample, `ss.sample.armor`, on the trait's tile. A trait is a stat, with nothing on the field to match it to, so since the level-up became a choice of which sample fills a syringe the slot shows the sample the trait was taken as, and the tray, the level-up card and the pause sheet agree on what it is. Composed through `use`, so redrawing the sample redraws the slot. The tile keeps its colour. (The weapons keep their projectiles: a weapon's slot has to match what it throws.)

evolved.description: Quicklime, the awakened Shell: the same plates on a gold tile, pulled in a little, with four blood arcs standing clear of them on the cardinals, the blow the plate stopped going outward instead of in. Arcs rather than a closed ring, so they read as something leaving rather than a badge; blood rather than ember, so they part from the gold rim at 32px.
